notes.title: v1.22: VR Fix (and latest Focus Engine)
notes.content:
v1.22 is a minor update, bringing the underlying Focus Engine to v4.14.8.

This should fix validation VR errors on startup, among possibly other minor performance issues.

This is my first update pushed on a new computer, so hopefully everything went fine :-D

I hope everyone is doing OK and thank you for sticking around :-)

- Phr00t

notes.title: v1.20: Fix world generation consistency for same seeds
notes.content:
I found a problem in world generation, similar to an issue I had with 8089, that caused consistent seeds to not be generated properly from world names. Now overall maps should be the same when using the same seed, which is particularly important for speedruns. Enemies, blocks and "tree" limbs will still be different for each map, as these are random small variations.

- Phr00t

notes.title: v1.18.4: Bug fixes, minor balancing & engine update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Abilities should reset to level 1 now when starting new games, regardless of previous games played
[*] Maximum capacity of weapons should now increase normally with level upgrades on new games (wasn't calculated or saved correctly before -- old saves will still function oddly)
[*] Charge Shot balancing: it upgraded exponentially too quickly before and was overpowered. It now is a bit weaker and upgrades slower
[*] Fixed a bug that caused cooldowns to not set properly when firing other weapons
[*] Upgraded FPS Infinite to the latest Focus Engine v3.25.1 (OpenXR + other improvements)
[/list]
If you enjoy this free game and updates, please consider leaving a recommendation and checking out my newest game:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1593280/8089_The_Next_Action_RPG/
Happy New Year all!

- Phr00t

notes.title: Update v1.17.2: lots of fixes!
notes.content:
FPS Infinite has been updated to v1.17 and includes an engine update and fixes.

1) Fixed the endgame timer to display the time correctly, instead of just 0:00
2) Fixed the mouse rotating unexpectedly when clicking different buttons
3) Fixed particles not rendering on Linux (got rid of the noparticles argument)
4) Improved position updates from OpenVR to reduce latency
5) Updated MacOS libraries, although Mac is not well supported (since OSX doesn't support Vulkan and support through MoltenVK is experimental).
6) Updated to Focus Engine v3.18.8 (which has other minor fixes/performance improvements)
7) Includes NET 5 in Mac/Linux builds now as standalone runtime

v1.17.2 should fix a crash on launch (reported @ https://steamcommunity.com/app/1256380/discussions/0/1744520688775831493/?ctp=5#c3047230236576040148 )

Enjoy!

notes.title: v1.15.21: Linux Fix + 5089 Sequel Testing Ramping Up!
notes.content:
If Linux has issues rendering particles, they should now automatically disable themselves and not require the "noparticles" argument. If you still have issues, or have new issues, you may have a distribution with an old libc6 version (like Debian). Use the "beta" branch called "old_libc6" if this is the case. I updated to SDL v2.0.14, which requires more recent libc6.

[h1]5089's sequel is making solid progress and more testers have been being picked.[/h1] You can join the Discord & show your interest in the #announcement channel:

https://discord.gg/8u2HDvh

notes.title: v1.5.11: Fullscreen fix + OpenVR update + 5089 Sequel Testing
notes.content:
Users were reporting fullscreen crashes and freezes, which upon investigation looks related to Windows 10 display scaling. This update should address the crashes, but depending on your scaling settings, you may still notice some odd behavior -- I recommend disabling the Windows 10 "fix blurry apps" option if you have scaling enabled and want to use this game fullscreen.

OpenVR has been updated to v1.14.15.

Testing has begun (albeit very limited) on 5089's sequel on Discord @ https://discord.gg/4quab2d

v1.5.9 should fix VR issues on AMD hardware.

v1.5.11 improves behavior when Windows 10 scaling is enabled and "fix blurry apps" is also enabled, although this combination is still problematic and error messages have been improved.

notes.title: FPS Infinite v1.5.1: Graphics Update + New VR Comfort Mode
notes.content:
FPS Infinite has been updated with improved water and fog shaders, Focus Engine v3.10.1 and a new VR comfort mode.

I removed the "teleport" VR mode, which didn't fit the genre and had its issues. Instead, a dynamic field of view reduction system is put in its place to manage motion sickness. It can be enabled in Options. If you had VR Teleport movement enabled before, this new Comfort Mode will be enabled already.

5089's sequel is just starting very early, alpha testing! You can see their screenshots and feedback, and be considered for testing yourself as testing expands. Join us on Discord @ https://discord.gg/4quab2d

v1.5.1 is a small engine update to capture more errors and improve UI rendering above very close objects.

notes.title: VR Update: Snap turn & traditional head movement
notes.content:
You asked for it, you got it! Snap turning can be enabled in Options, and the traditional head movement is now default (but can be turned off in Options).

The right touchpad's left/right is used to perform 90 degree turns when "Snap Turn" is enabled. If you have a saved game using those buttons already, make sure you reassign them in-game using the handheld display (you can point to abilities to reassign them).

Hopefully things are stable & I can start focusing on the next big thing: 5089's sequel!
